title: Quaint Steamed Norwegian Daikon Skewers
description: A malty and shaggy Norwegian dish featuring daikon, perfect for a brunch mood, made keto-friendly by using low-carb ingredients and steaming method, served in a bamboo steamer.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together malt syrup, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the daikon cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the malt syrup mixture.
Thread the daikon cubes onto bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers in a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper.
Steam the daikon skewers over boiling water for 10 minutes, or until they are tender.
While the daikon is steaming, mix the chopped parsley and dill in a small bowl.
After the daikon has finished steaming, brush the lemon juice over the daikon cubes.
Sprinkle the parsley and dill mixture over the daikon skewers and serve hot.
